key_audit_finding: Only 1 of the 34 standard weekends (Abu Dhabi 2024, Round 24) has locally cached practice payloads in data/raw/openf1/practice/ (FP1 9461, FP2 9656, FP3 9657). Silverstone 2024 has session keys cached, but laps/stints are unpopulated. The remaining 32 weekends have zero local practice telemetry. Claiming full 34-race practice coverage was an artifact of conflating provider-level existence with local data presence.
